title: useCycle Hook
description:
Implement a `useCycle` hook that cycles through a fixed array of values and returns `[current, next, prev]`. `next()` advances to the next item (wrapping from last to first). `prev()` goes back (wrapping from first to last).

**Example:**
```tsx
const [color, next, prev] = useCycle(['red', 'green', 'blue']);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: the prev wrap formula — using (index - 1) % items.length returns -1 in JavaScript when index is 0. The correct formula is (index - 1 + items.length) % items.length.
